one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1130」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
Purchase from the J. H. Wade Fund

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → southern-song；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

"Part II. Eighteenth Annual Report of the Cleveland Museum of Art 1933." The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art 21, no. 2 (February 1934): 1–15.（Mentioned: p. 4）

dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text:
好山無數接天涯，烟靄陰晴日夕佳。  
要識先生會到此，故留筆戲在君家。  

庚戍歲，辟地新昌作。元暉。  

[seal]  元暉戲作

馆方英译：Artist's inscription:
Fine hills are endless toward the edges of heaven.
So are mist and cloud, rain and shine, days and nights.
Had I known that you’d be visiting here.
I would have left this playful work in your home.

In the year of gengxu [1130], [I painted this] while seeking refuge in Xinchang. Yuanhui.

[seal]  “Yuan hui xi zuo” (Yuanhui playfully made this)

[Seal] 安陽孫氏

馆方英译：Anyang Sun shi

[Seal] 畢瀧

馆方英译：Bi Long

[Seal] 成親王

馆方英译：Prince Cheng

[Seal] 錫三 appears twice

馆方英译：Xisan

[Seal] 養性齋珍藏書畫印

馆方英译：Calligraphy and painting in the collection of the Yangxing studio (Yangxing zhai zhen cang shu hua yin)

[Seal] 芷陔審定真跡

馆方英译：authenticated by Zhigai [Li Zaixian 李在銛] (Zhigai shen ding zhen ji)

[Seal]  玉簡齋

馆方英译：Yujian Studio (Yu jian zhai)
2 colophons (1 dated 1650), inscription dated 1647, and 2 seals of Wang To (1592–1652)
1 colophon, dated second month of the gengyin year 庚寅 (1650), and 2 seals of Chen Kuang 陳爌 (1646 jinshi degree)

A separate scroll containing six colophons on Cloudy Mountains exists; the inscribers are Luo Zhenyu 羅振玉 (1866–1940), Naito Torajiro 內藤虎次郎 (1866–1934), Nagao Ko 長尾甲 (1864–1942), and Wu Changshuo 吳昌碩 (1844–1927). Naito Torajiro alone wrote three colophons.
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。
